label: Diagram 8.3
caption: Diagram 8.3 Construction of protected shafts | Uninsulated glazed screens to protected shafts
description:
This is a plan (top-down) view showing three enclosed spaces labelled A, B and C, drawn with thick green lines and set within a larger rectangle drawn with thin black lines. A leader line from the label "Compartment wall" points to the central vertical wall, and a leader line from "External wall" points to the left wall of shaft A. A legend at top right reads "Fd Fire doorset".

Shaft A, on the left, is a horizontal rectangle containing a series of vertical parallel lines in its left part and one "Fd" door on its right edge; the caption below it reads "Protected shaft A is bounded on three sides by compartment walls and on the fourth side by an external wall".

Shaft B, in the centre, is a vertical rectangle with two "Fd" doors, one on its upper left wall and one on its upper right wall, and a series of horizontal parallel lines in its lower part; its caption reads "Protected shaft B is bounded on four sides by compartment walls".

Shaft C, on the right, is a smaller rectangle containing four small circles stacked along its left wall and one "Fd" door at its top right; its caption reads "Protected shaft C is a services duct bounded on four sides by compartment walls".

Introductory and concluding text appears above and below the plan.
